name: Minecraft: Java Edition

ports.label: Game
ports.ask: Port your world or server is on (Open to LAN prints it in chat)

steps: Single-player world: press Esc → Open to LAN → Start LAN World. TailLAN spots the port automatically.
Or run a Minecraft server (it listens on port 25565 by default).
Click Start sharing and send the invite code to your friends.
{{hostname}}'s world should appear under LAN games. If not: Direct Connection → {{connect}}

notes: Everyone needs the same Minecraft version. Modded games need the same mods.
